findings.title: The native public gift-selection condition can change remaining ownership weights without being marked as an unencoded constraint.
findings.impact: A foreign giver who may still hold the other same-suit/rank physical copy satisfies the recorded gift only for half of its native copy orders. If it holds either of the two other remaining cards, both copy orders satisfy the gift. The actual legal posterior is[0.4,0.4,0.2], not an unconditioned1/3 ownership prior, yet gaps=[] because the current maximum predicate checks only strictly greater rankOrder and skips the equal-rank/native-copy selection restriction. This is a concrete necessary public constraint absent from331; it must not be treated as a generally eligible represented root.
findings.requestedClosure: Before labels, flag unresolved foreign-giver constraints from native earlier suit selection and same-suit copy selection as well as strictly higher powers. Account for pre-exchange known ownership and private-copy/order uncertainty. Actor pre-exchange ownership is fixed and should retain its valid direct conditioning/constant-factor treatment. Do not change eligibility according to scores or support rates.
findings.uniformityNote: The sampler itself correctly preserves the conditional rejection weight on this fixture; the defect is the representation eligibility declaration, not the measured posterior.

findings.title: An observation claiming that the previous round already passedA can still be sampled as an active continuation.
findings.minimalCounterexample: Take the genuine seed713 second-round observation, change only matchPublic.lastResult.passedA totrue, recompute the observation SHA and call sampleVisibleWorld. The frozen002 returns a world with winner:null.
findings.impact: The input has a type-valid but semantically terminal public predecessor. A match that ended on the preceding round cannot have an active current continuation. Constructing winner:null must not erase that terminal fact or admit it to complete-match teacher targets.
findings.requestedClosure: Reject prior lastResult.passedA=true at both the visible/public-match ingress and the shared continuation-root guard, preserving ordinary nonterminal first/second-round positives. No labels from this domain may be generated.

conditionalUniformityReview.allocationBaseMeasure: For fixed own/public facts, unseen ownership allocations of physical IDs are proposed with equal multiplicity. Reversing recorded transfers is a bijection to pre-exchange ownership. Native sorting removes irrelevant rank/suit order; conditional on ownership, each identical-copy order is sampled uniformly.
conditionalUniformityReview.foreignGiftWeight: Do not force an observed foreign gift copy to the front. If both copies belong to the giver, the recorded copy is selected with probability1/2; if only that copy belongs to it, the probability is1. Rejection by actual frozen applyTribute therefore preserves the correct posterior weights. In the independent three-allocation fixture the six deterministic copy-order branches give masses1,1,1/2 and normalized probabilities0.4,0.4,0.2.512 actual draws give205,206,101, requiring623 total proposals. These counts are descriptive; the exact argument establishes the intended weights under the pseudorandom shuffle assumption.
conditionalUniformityReview.actorConditioning: Current actor cards, its public plays and complete transfer flows fix the actor pre-exchange ownership set independently of foreign allocation. Its observed remaining copy order and own gift impose a constant conditioning factor across foreign worlds. Conditioning those actor facts directly is legitimate; it must not be generalized to force foreign copies or suit choices.
conditionalUniformityReview.nativeRuntimeIdentity: The initial sorted hand, public append sequence and deletion of public plays preserve the policy representation used by the frozen v2-compatible opponent. This does not introduce an alternative candidate policy or independently rescore any model.
conditionalUniformityReview.noSourceTruthFallback: The sampler still derives worlds from VisibleRoot/deck/caller seed only and throws on exhaustion. Original source hidden order/RNG and future action/outcome are not consumed in the inspected sampling path.

dslAndFourSeatReview.representedFacts: Whitelisted count/finished/target/team-level/control fields are recoverable from actual317+14 and actor-known legal candidates under frozen DEFAULT_RULES. partnerLastPass is represented by the partner recent-move pass bit. This does not assert that arbitrary full public history is a sufficient statistic.
dslAndFourSeatReview.runtimeBehavior: Only explicit actor turns are considered; condition initialization, permanent invalidation, bounded not-triggered/missing-action fallback and per-move caching are retained. The program stops at the next actual round. It never manufactures an action outside the current legal candidate set.
dslAndFourSeatReview.forcedRoot: The exact forced root combo reference is retained. Its necessary action key must match the first explicit plan step; the step is consumed once. A different first action, wrong rootId, partner control and arbitrary/hidden predicates reject.
